summary.en: Israel has intensified cross-border strikes, hitting a Hezbollah weapons shipment in the eastern Beqaa Valley and demolishing a Hezbollah tunnel in southern Lebanon, while a low-flying Israeli drone was filmed over homes in the south. US envoy Waltz visited Beirut demanding Hezbollah disarmament and condemning recent attacks. Iraq deployed its army to a stronghold of Iran-backed Kataib Hezbollah, linking the broader regional fight to the Israel-Hezbollah clash. The conflict has caused 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Israel har økt grenseoverskridende angrep, rammet en Hezbollah-våpenforsendelse i den østlige Beqaadalen og revet ned en Hezbollah-tunnel i sørlige Libanon, mens en lavtflygende israelsk drone ble filmet over hus i sør. US-utsending Waltz besøkte Beirut og krevde at Hezbollah avlegger våpnene og fordømte de siste angrepene. Irak satte inn hæren i en festning til den Iran-støttede Kataib Hezbollah, og knyttet den bredere regionale kampen til konflikten mellom Israel og Hezbollah. Konflikten har forårsaket 4 335 drepte i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Hezbollah–Israel conflict (2023–present)
background.extract: An ongoing conflict between the Lebanese militant group Hezbollah and Israel began on 8 October 2023, when Hezbollah launched rockets and artillery at Israeli positions following Hamas's October 7 attacks on Israel. The conflict escalated into a prolonged exchange of bombardments, leading to extensive displacement in Israel and Lebanon. The conflict is part of the broader Middle Eastern crisis that began with Hamas's attack, with the short Israeli invasion of Lebanon in 2024 marking the largest escalation of the Hezbollah–Israel conflict since the 2006 Lebanon War. In Arabic, the conflict (2023–2024) is referred to as the "Support War" or the "Gaza Support War."
